entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The climactic explosion that ended the Brothers' War on Dominaria in 63 AR.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artisan who activated the Golgothian Sylex, was disintegrated, then resurrected as a planeswalker.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, who had become a Phyrexian and was disintegrated by the blast.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Urza activated to cause the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Island almost entirely vaporized by the blast.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice, rescued by Urza and told to tell the story.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Urza's son, aboard a ship when the blast occurred.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Harbin's mother, who assumed him dead.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Unseen influence behind the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Bubble that trapped twelve planes away from the multiverse and protected Dominaria from Phyrexia for almost 3,000 years.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Planeswalker who called the upheaval the Cataclysm of the Twelve Planes.

events.summary: Urza realizes Mishra has become a Phyrexian and activates the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: Urza used his newly found magical skills to activate the Golgothian Sylex

events.summary: The blast vaporizes nearly all of Argoth and sends a shock wave across Terisiare.
events.quote: instantly vaporized all but a fraction of Argoth

events.summary: Urza and Mishra are disintegrated; the Mightstone and Weakstone unite to resurrect Urza as a planeswalker.
events.quote: the Mightstone and Weakstone were united to resurrect Urza as a planeswalker

events.summary: Urza rescues Tawnos and tells him to tell the story, then leaves Dominaria.
Harbin's ship is hit by a giant wave; he never reaches Penregon and is assumed dead.
events.quote: Urza's son Harbin was aboard a ship headed for the mainland when the blast occured.

events.summary: The Shard of the Twelve Worlds forms, shielding Dominaria from Phyrexia for almost 3,000 years.
events.quote: Dominaria began to form the Shard of the Twelve Worlds

relations.note: Urza activated the Sylex to cause it
relations.quote: Urza used his newly found magical skills to activate the Golgothian Sylex
Urza's son Harbin was aboard a ship headed for the mainland when the blast occured.
